title: Gyāna Chopad
subtitleGu: ભારતીય જ્ઞાન અને કર્મનું શૈક્ષણિક ચોપડ
description: Educational adaptation inspired by traditional Indian Gyan Chaupar (72-square Vaishnava-style layouts). Original educational design for V1.0. Not a reconstruction of any single historical board.
notes: Win condition and exact-roll rule are configurable game mechanics for clarity and fairness in multiplayer play. Traditional boards varied in win square placement and movement rules.
